conventions.convention: Full Axiom of Choice is assumed for the knot Seifert pairing and Alexander-module results; it supplies the weaker countable-choice hypotheses of their geometric prerequisites.
The spanning surface is connected, compact, smooth, oriented and embedded, with its boundary orientation equal to the given knot orientation. Its first homology has rank 2g, including rank zero.

The positive normal satisfies (n,u,v)>0 in the ambient three-sphere for a positive tangent basis (u,v) of the surface. Matrix entries are V_ij = lk(a_i^+,a_j), with the first argument pushed positively.
Surface intersections count the ordered tangent pair positively when it gives the surface orientation; consequently the stated skew-part identity is V−Vᵀ = J_F.
The stack glues S_−(Y_n) to S_+(Y_(n+1)). The shift t increases the sheet index and corresponds to the positive meridian. In linking-dual column coordinates, i_− has matrix V and i_+ has matrix Vᵀ.

Basis vectors transform by a_j = Σ_i b_i P_ij, so matrices transform by PᵀVP. S-equivalence permits determinant ±1 congruences and precisely the two displayed rank-two enlargement moves and their reverses.
The isotopy lemma assumes an ambient isotopy carrying the entire oriented knot–surface pair to the target pair; it does not assert that arbitrary spanning surfaces are ambient isotopic.

load_bearing.statement: Assume the Axiom of Choice. For a smooth oriented knot K, a connected compact smooth oriented embedded spanning surface F with matching boundary orientation, and an ordered integral homology basis, use V_ij = lk(a_i^+,a_j) and the positive-meridian deck variable t. Then A_K ≅ coker(V−tVᵀ) over Z[t^{±1}].

Under full AC and the stated oriented knot–surface and positive-push conventions, the linking formula is independent of homology representatives and sufficiently small positive push-off, is bilinear on H_1(F;Z), and linking of disjoint oriented circle components is symmetric.

Under full AC and the stated adapted tube, oriented proper cut surface and stack conventions, Y is connected, its first homology is identified with the integral dual of H_1(F) by linking evaluation, and H_1(F)⊗Λ → H_1(Y)⊗Λ → H_1(Ẽ_F) → 0 is exact with first map i_−−t i_+.

Assume the Axiom of Choice and the stated oriented knot–surface and positive-push conventions. Then V−Vᵀ = J_F, where J_F is the ordered surface-intersection matrix. It is skew-symmetric and unimodular, and in a standard handle basis it is a direct sum of blocks ((0,1),(−1,0)).
Under full AC and the specified positive-normal, linking-dual and positive-meridian stack conventions, the map i_−−t i_+ has matrix V−tVᵀ. Consequently H_1(Ẽ_F;Z) is its cokernel.

Assume the Axiom of Choice. An orientation-preserving smooth ambient isotopy carrying one oriented knot–surface pair to another preserves the Seifert matrix in the transported basis; another integral target basis gives V′ = PᵀVP. Hence the matrices are S-equivalent.

seams_checked.note: The cut-open construction uses the chosen product tube, exterior retraction, positive meridian, and unique degree-one null-homologous longitude with their stated hypotheses.
Uses of linking/intersection equality supply spanning surfaces, regular diagrams and transversality. The mixed-crossing symmetry agrees with the positive-meridian normalization.
Connectedness, compactness, smoothness, boundary orientation and genus conventions are preserved. Full AC discharges the surface suppliers' countable-choice assumptions.
Consumers use coker(V−tVᵀ), unimodular skew part and basis congruence with the same positive-push and positive-meridian conventions, including the empty matrix.
The cyclic-cover order calculation uses the stated Alexander-module presentation and the unimodularity of V−Vᵀ. Pairing and basis-change citations preserve the matrix convention.

Consumers retain the positive-push pairing, ordered intersection form and exact enlargement matrices. Arbitrary-surface S-equivalence is proved separately rather than attributed to the pair-isotopy lemma.
The metabolic-form definition and slice-metabolizer argument use the bilinear positive-push pairing and its unimodular skew part under full AC.
Realization and isometric-structure consumers preserve the pairing and skew-part conventions; enlargement calculations use exactly the displayed E_0 and E_1 matrices.
